headline: North Korea Expels Swiss Ambassador After Bern's Sanctions
summary: North Korea expelled the head of Switzerland's diplomatic office in Pyongyang and ordered the ambassador to leave the country within 48 hours, following sanctions imposed by Bern.
why: Sanctions against North Korea restrict trade and financial flows, and diplomatic escalations can affect sanctions compliance for firms with exposure to the region.
original_headline: Corea del Norte expulsa al embajador suizo tras sanciones de Berna
